<div class="course-preparation-header">
<div class="course-preparation-header-main">
<div class="course-page-label">Preparation</div>
<h1 class="course-page-title">Prepare for the training</h1>
<p class="course-page-intro course-page-intro-narrow">Use this page to provide participants with the accounts, software, hardware, reading, and other information they need before attending the training.
</p>
</div>
<div class="course-page-contact">
<div class="course-page-contact-icon"><i class="bi bi-envelope"></i></div>
<div class="course-page-contact-title">Questions about the training?</div>
<p>Get in touch with the training team.</p>
<a class="course-text-link" href="mailto:training@example.org">training@example.org</a>
</div>
</div>
<div class="course-preparation">
<section class="course-preparation-section">
<div class="course-preparation-text">
<p>Use the `checklist` block type to provide participants with a simple overview of the preparation tasks they need to complete before the training. Add one item for each required or recommended activity.</p>
</div>
<div class="course-preparation-box course-preparation-checklist">
<div class="course-preparation-box-header">
<i class="bi bi-check2-square course-preparation-box-icon"></i>
<h3 class="course-preparation-box-title">
Preparation checklist
</h3>
</div>
<div class="course-preparation-box-body">
<ul>
<li><label><input type="checkbox" class="course-preparation-checkbox"><span>Complete preparation task 1</span></label></li>
<li><label><input type="checkbox" class="course-preparation-checkbox"><span>Complete preparation task 2</span></label></li>
<li><label><input type="checkbox" class="course-preparation-checkbox"><span>Complete preparation task 3</span></label></li>
<li><label><input type="checkbox" class="course-preparation-checkbox"><span>Complete preparation task 4</span></label></li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="course-preparation-section">
<h2>Accounts</h2>
<div class="course-preparation-text">
<p>Describe the accounts participants need to create or access before the training. Use the `account` block type for each account and provide a description, instructions, and relevant links.</p>
</div>
<div class="course-preparation-account-grid">
<div class="course-preparation-box course-preparation-account">

<i class="bi bi-person-badge course-preparation-box-icon"></i>
<h3 class="course-preparation-box-title">
Account 1
</h3>
</div>
<div class="course-preparation-box-body">
<div class="course-preparation-resource-description">
<p>Briefly explain what the account is, why participants need it, and how it will be used during the training.</p>
</div>
<div class="course-preparation-instructions">
<h4>Instructions</h4>
<p>Provide the steps participants should follow to create or configure the account.</p>
<ol>
<li>Create account step 1.</li>
<li>Create account step 2.</li>
<li>Create account step 3.</li>
</ol>
</div>
<ul class="course-preparation-links">

<li>

</li>

</div>

Account 2
</h3>

<div class="course-preparation-box-body">

</div>
<div class="course-preparation-instructions">
<h4>Instructions</h4>
<p>Provide the steps participants should follow to create or configure this account.</p>

<div class="course-preparation-callout-content">

<section class="course-preparation-section">
<h2>Hardware requirements</h2>
<div class="course-preparation-text">
<p>Describe the computer or other equipment participants need to bring or have access to. Use the `hardware` block type to specify requirements such as RAM, storage, processor, or internet connection.</p>
</div>
<div class="course-preparation-box course-preparation-hardware">
<div class="course-preparation-box-header">
<i class="bi bi-laptop course-preparation-box-icon"></i>
<h3 class="course-preparation-box-title">
Hardware 1
</h3>
</div>
<div class="course-preparation-box-body">
<div class="course-preparation-resource-description">
<p>Describe the equipment participants need and include any minimum technical requirements.</p>
</div>
<dl class="course-preparation-requirements">
<div>
<dt>RAM</dt>
<dd>Minimum requirement</dd>
</div>
<div>
<dt>Storage</dt>
<dd>Minimum requirement</dd>
</div>
<div>
<dt>Processor</dt>
<dd>Requirement</dd>
</div>
<div>
<dt>Internet</dt>
<dd>Requirement</dd>
</div>
</dl>
<div class="course-preparation-instructions">
<h4>Instructions</h4>
<p>Provide any additional information participants should know, such as whether they need to bring their own computer, charger, headset, or other equipment.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="course-preparation-callout course-preparation-callout-note">
<div class="course-preparation-callout-title">
<i class="bi bi-sticky course-preparation-callout-icon"></i>
This is a note callout
</div>
<div class="course-preparation-callout-content">
<p>Use a **note** callout for useful background information, tips, reminders, or other information that does not require the stronger emphasis of an **important** or **warning** callout.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="course-preparation-section">

<a href="https://example.org" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
